t: A Talk Near the Future of Python (a.k.a., Dave live-codes a WebAssembly Interpreter)

q.x: I found this video [link] "A Talk Near the Future of Python (a.k.a., Dave live-codes a WebAssembly Interpreter)" to be a brilliant introduction to WASM as well as writing interpreters in general.

desc:
Closing Keynote Talk - PyCon India, Chennai, October 13, 2019 (Screencast).  

In this talk, I live-code a simple stack machine and turn it into an interpreter capable of running WebAssembly.  I then use that to play a game written in Rust.

Code written during the talk can be found at https://gist.github.com/dabeaz/7d8838b54dba5006c58a40fc28da9d5a

If you like this sort of madness and want to go
